summary: The note describes the Constitution of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam, the country's current constitution. It was adopted on 28 November 2013 by the Thirteenth National Assembly and took effect on 1 January 2014. It is the fourth constitution the Vietnamese government has adopted since the country's political reunification in 1976.
one_line: Vietnam's current constitution, adopted by the Thirteenth National Assembly in 2013 and in force since January 2014.
key_facts: The Constitution of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam is the current constitution of Vietnam.
The Constitution of Vietnam was adopted on 28 November 2013.
The Constitution of Vietnam was adopted by the Thirteenth National Assembly.
The Constitution of Vietnam took effect on 1 January 2014.
The Constitution of Vietnam is the fourth constitution adopted by the Vietnamese government since the political reunification of the country in 1976.
